title: Sentences

dress.note: Present tense: she puts on, in the third person singular.

shoes.note: Present tense: he puts on, in the third person singular.

size.sentenceGloss: A shirt of size forty two is needed.
size.note: Genitive: the ordinal takes the genitive after розміру.

have.sentenceGloss: My shoe size is thirty nine.
have.note: The ordinal stays in the nominative: it names the size itself.

trying.sentenceGloss: The customer is trying on an overcoat.
trying.note: Present tense: the customer tries on, in the third person singular.

buying.note: Present tense: she buys, in the third person singular.

summary: Use the lemma or the meaning fixed by the sentence to supply the missing form.
